title: Buga Sphere matched to a 9-litre fuel tank

tellings.quote: So, there's a particular shape of fuel tank that is exactly 9 L and and it's got similar holes to the one that Yummy is relying on

plain: In Buga, a town in Colombia, a metal ball known as the Buga Sphere drew attention in 2025, and some people treat it as a possible object of unknown origin. Ross Coulthart, a journalist who covers UFO claims, said on a podcast that a man named Ronnie Vernet had pointed him to a type of fuel tank that holds exactly 9 litres and has holes much like the sphere's. If the match holds, the sphere would be an ordinary manufactured part rather than anything strange.
